phase: 1 - grooming and training end-to-end, driven in a real browser with demo data
method: First audit method in this whole engagement that uses a browser. The app was run locally (vite dev, port 5173), a customer was created through the REAL OTP sign-in path (/api/customer-otp request -> verify, sandbox code returned in-band, liveSmsDelivered:false), a pet and a Bengaluru address were added through the real /api/customer-account surface, and the journey was driven in Chromium via Playwright.
measured: Signed in as that customer, /training resolved its training zone from the address PIN ('East Bengaluru · confirmed from your address PIN code'), listed an eligible trainer, priced the plan ('Rs 3,000 sandbox amount due now · live money disabled') and ENABLED the booking button. Pressing it showed the customer, verbatim: NO_SCHEDULE_AVAILABLE
what_was_actually_wrong: The refusal itself was CORRECT - no trainer had published availability for the chosen date. That is not the defect.
A machine code was rendered as customer copy.

The server had ALREADY computed the human explanation and returned it: {"error":"NO_SCHEDULE_AVAILABLE","evaluations":[{"providerName":"Kiran S.","eligible":false,"reasons":["No published availability on 2026-08-30"]}]}. lib/uat-scheduling-client.ts kept `body.error` and discarded every bit of it.
fix: lib/uat-scheduling-client.ts now maps refusal codes to sentences, appends the server's own reason when every ineligible provider gave the same one, and falls back to a generic sentence for an UNMAPPED code so a future refusal token can never reach a customer either.
verified_in_the_browser: the same click now shows 'No provider is available for the date and time you chose. Please pick another slot.'
regression: tests/ptja-p1-scheduling-refusal-message.test.mjs - 4 cases, RED-first (3 of 4 failed before the fix)
severity: Not security, not money. It is the difference between a customer who knows to pick another date and one who sees a stack-trace fragment and leaves.
not_claimed: This is one screen and one refusal path. Other client modules may discard server explanations the same way; that has NOT been swept.
The local run enables UAT login through a gitignored .dev.vars. No secret was printed or committed, and nothing in the repository's deployed configuration was changed.
